description: Combine two or more local PDFs into a single file, in the order given. Runs entirely on this machine with pdf-lib — nothing is uploaded and no URL is fetched. Refuses to overwrite an existing output unless overwrite is true.

inputPaths.description: The PDFs to merge, in the order they should appear in the result.

items.description: A PDF to merge. Absolute, or relative to the client's working directory.

outputPath.description: Where to write the merged PDF. Absolute, or relative to the client's working directory.

overwrite.description: Replace outputPath if a file is already there.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
